content: Remove this user from the agent? Their conversations with this agent, including the files in them, will be permanently deleted. Inviting them again will not restore these conversations.

comment.text: Body text of the Remove user confirmation dialog shown when an agent (AI project) manager removes a member from the agent; warns that the server permanently deletes every conversation (chat thread) that member started in the agent, with its files, and that a new invitation does not bring them back.
